title: The local map to H and normalized quotient maps separate sections
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ coherent and $N$ a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $(U_i)$ be arbitrary opens. Supply coherent $H_i=H|_{U_i}$, coherent $F_i$, maps $a_i:F_i\to H_i$ with actual kernel and cokernel annihilated by a positive power of $J|_{U_i}$, and $\beta_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F_i^\wedge$. Supply over-site modules $L_i$, isomorphisms $l_i:L_i\cong F_i$, and maps $b_i:L_i\to H|_{U_i}$ and $q_{i,n}:L_i\to N_n|_{U_i}$ whose transfers are $l_i a_i$ and $l_i\pi_{F_i,n}\beta_{i,n}^{-1}$. For any $i$ and open $W\subseteq U_i$, two sections of $L_i$ on $W$ with equal images under $b_i$ and every $q_{i,n}$ are equal. No map from $N$ to $H^\wedge$, compatibility with such a map, or overlap comparison is required.

source.place: Tag 0889(1), omitted uniqueness verification via the Artin--Rees separation argument

proof.text: Fix i. From the supplied kernel bound obtain a level n for which ker(ai) maps monomorphically to Fi/J^(n+1)Fi. The open Ui is Noetherian, since open subspaces of a Noetherian space are compact and restriction is locally Noetherian.

In the over-site form c=(bi,qi,op n) mapping Li to the biproduct of H and N_n. To prove c monic, let d compose with c to zero. Its compositions with both projections vanish. Transfer d through overEquiv and li to v. The normalization equations give v ai=0 and v pi=0, cancelling beta inverse for the latter. Factor v through ker(ai). Cancel the Artin--Rees monomorphism, so this factor and v vanish. Faithfulness of overEquiv and invertibility of li give d=0.

Evaluation on W preserves monomorphisms. Evaluate c. Equality of its two projections follows from the assumed b and q equalities. The biproduct identity fst inl+snd inr=id, evaluated on these sections, shows their c-images equal. Cancel the evaluated monomorphism to obtain equality of sections.

theorem torsion_local_section_separation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (Hlocal : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (hHlocal : ∀ i, (Hlocal i).obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj H.obj)
    (Fi : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (ai : ∀ i, Fi i ⟶ Hlocal i)
    (βi : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Fi i).obj)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel (ai i).hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel (ai i).hom)))
    (Li : ∀ i, SheafOfModules ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (U i)))
    (li : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.obj (Li i) ≅ (Fi i).obj)
    (bi : ∀ i, Li i ⟶ H.obj.over (U i))
    (qi : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), Li i ⟶ (N.obj.obj n).over (U i))
    (hbi : (∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (bi i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app H.obj ≫
          eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm = (li i).hom ≫ (ai i).hom))
    (hqi : (∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (qi i n) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app (N.obj.obj n) =
          (li i).hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n.unop + 1) (Fi i).obj ≫
            (βi i).inv.app n))
    (i : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i)
    (x y : (Li i).val.obj (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))))
    (hb : (bi i).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) x =
      (bi i).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) y)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (qi i n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) x =
      (qi i n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) y) : x = y
